create.name: Caroline Stewart
create.bio:
Caroline Stewart is a meditation and breathwork teacher and business coach based in Edmonton, Alberta. She trained first as a nurse and later qualified as a yoga teacher and meditation teacher, and over some twenty years she has set up several businesses in wellness and personal growth. Through her school, Soul-Aligned Wellness, she runs two online teacher trainings: a 200-hour course for people who want to teach meditation and a 300-hour course for breathwork facilitators.

Both trainings are self-paced, with video, audio, manuals and a practicum, and they borrow from several traditions rather than teaching one fixed style, leaving room for each student to find their own way of guiding. Alongside them she coaches spiritually minded founders on vision, offers and the practical side of running a business, and hosts the podcast All The Way Alive. On Insight Timer she shares guided meditations, breathwork and yoga nidra, along with short courses on writing your own meditations, visioning and the basics of breathwork. She also makes resin and wood art by hand.

courses.title: 200hr Meditation Teacher Training
courses.description: An online, self-paced certification in teaching meditation, grounded in mindfulness and drawing on several traditions. Students have two years to finish the modules, quizzes and practicum, and most take three to four months.

courses.title: 300hr Breathwork Facilitator Training
courses.description: A self-paced online certification covering breath theory, a wide range of techniques and how to design your own guided breathwork journeys. The practicum includes a thirty-day breath log and two recorded journeys, with two years of access.

courses.title: Soul-Aligned Business Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one strategy work for coaches, practitioners and other heart-led business owners, covering vision, offers, courses, funnels and websites. It starts with an application for a strategy session.

courses.title: Create + Guide Authentic Meditations
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course from Caroline on creating meditations and guiding them in your own voice, drawn from her teacher-training work.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Breathwork Foundations
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course from Caroline that introduces the groundwork of conscious breathing practice.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Caroline Stewart on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, breathwork sessions and yoga nidra from Caroline, in audio and video. Free to listen in the app or on the web.
